name: Lineups render at a 360px viewport without horizontal scroll
description: When a visitor opens the Lineups panel on a match page at a 360 pixel mobile viewport, the two team columns stack vertically and the eleven starting players for the home team remain visible without the body producing a horizontal scrollbar.

planSteps.description: Resize the viewport to 360 pixels wide
Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Open the Lineups tab or scroll to the lineups region
Verify the home team's eleven starting player rows are visible and the document body does not produce a horizontal scrollbar at the 360 pixel viewport
